title: feat(nsuozinc): nsopp z-probe same-tick union own-lock: reverse fails, face HOLD
science: Same-tick union own lock on nsopp z-probes; union is a no-op. Face flips fail -> hold purely from the same-tick mixed neighbour (0,1,2) entering S(C), while reverse still fails on {+e1,+e3} vs {+e1,+e3}. Supplies the same-tick z-probe cell.
